name: Exit, stage left
source:
It's opening night at the theater, but your time there has come to a close.

You pack up the last of your belongings and head for the door. Maybe you can escape without having to talk to anyone.

Exit, stage left is a visual novel about responsibility, fairness and the devastation of losing a job you love

[from [url=https://games-for-people.itch.io/exit-stage-left]itch.io[/url]]
